newsitem.title: ITALY: SOCCER-REGGIANA DISMISS ROMANIAN COACH LUCESCU.
newsitem.headline: SOCCER-REGGIANA DISMISS ROMANIAN COACH LUCESCU.

text.p: Reggiana, bottom of Italy's serie A and without a win all season, sacked Romanian coach Mircea Lucescu on Monday.
The club, promoted last season when current Parma coach Carlo Ancelotti was in charge, decided to replace Lucescu at a board meeting.
The decision came as no surprise after the 2-0 defeat at league leaders Vicenza on Sunday, which followed a home loss to Bologna the previous weekend.

Under Lucescu, who has now been dismissed three times in seven seasons in Italy, Reggiana have scored only nine goals in 10 league matches -- the lowest tally of the 18 top division clubs -- while conceding in 19.
No replacement was immediately named for the former Romanian national coach, who arrived in Italy from Dinamo Bucharest in 1990 when he took over as coach of Pisa.
That job lasted a year before he was dismissed and moved to Brescia, where he stayed in charge from 1991 to 1995.
Lucescu was the second serie A coach to be fired this season after Cagliari's Uruguayan Gregorio Perez in October.
